item.title: Niigata Girls' Trip: Sake Tasting, Snow Country Ryokan & Sado Island Adventure
item.description: Niigata Prefecture Girls' Group Travel Guide Niigata Prefecture, stretching along the Sea of Japan coast, offers the perfect blend of sake culture, snow country romance, and off-the-beaten-path adventure for international women travelers. This is Japan’s rice and sake heartland—a place where winter blankets everything in pristine white, where art installations emerge from rice paddies, and where sharing a carafe of cold local sake becomes an unforgettable bonding ritual. 1. Niigata Sake Tasting Girls' Group The Ponshukan Experience
